count.description: How many distinct principals must sign off before a transition into the state.

excludeCreator.description: Whether the principal who created the instance is refused a sign-off; true when absent.

from.description: The states of the type's Workflow a transition from is gated; every state when absent.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to sign off.

gates.description: The gates, by the state of the type's Workflow each gates.

resetOnChange.description: Whether a change of the instance's own fields, an update or an operation's, consumes every gate's sign-offs; true when absent.

permission.description: The permission a principal needs to assign the instance to another principal, reassign it, or unassign another principal. Absent, only the first two self-service moves are possible.

copyFields.description: Fields of this type copied to every child, a field of the child's type of the same name.

copyLinks.description: Links of this type copied to every child, a link of the child's Links config of the same name to the same schema, keeping the revision or the release this instance's link records where the child's pins the same: the links the instance holds when it is stamped, which for inline steps are the ones its create gives.

from.description: Where the steps are kept as an instance: a link of this type's Links config pinned to a revision, and the field of the linked instance that holds a map of steps of the same form as steps. The steps are read from the revision the link pins and stamped when the link is first set, by the create that gives it or a later link.

field.description: The field of the linked instance's type that holds the steps.

link.description: A link of this type's Links config pinned to a revision.

keyField.description: A string field of the child schema's type that each child gets its step's key in.

parentLink.description: The link of the child schema's Links config that points at this schema; each child is linked to its parent through it.

schema.description: The child schema. It composes Links with parentLink, Constants over keyField and every copied field, Dependencies when a step comes after another, and not Blueprint.

after.description: The keys of the steps whose children block this step's child.

data.description: Fields of the child, beside its key and the copied fields.

when.description: Stamps the step only when the instance's field equals a value, or is a list that includes one; absent, always.

equals.description: The value the field must equal, as JSON.

field.description: A field of this schema's type.

includes.description: A value the field, a list, must include, as JSON.

steps.description: The steps, by key, stamped when the instance is created.

order.description: The kind's integer field that orders siblings, as @graphMember's order.

parent.description: Containment, as @graphMember's parent: key is the kind's field, of a UUID scalar, that holds the parent row's entity key, and of is the parent's kind, this one included. Deleting a parent removes its descendants.

retentionDays.description: How many days of the kind's history the sweep keeps, as @versioned's retentionDays; all of it when absent.

singleton.description: At most one live row of the kind, as @graphMember's singleton.

type.description: The type of the schema document, besides the instance type, whose fields are the kind's content.

units.description: A field's conflict unit, as @conflictUnit sets it: atomic (the default), keyed (each top-level key of a JSON object), jsonSchema, or excluded (not content: never merged or hashed).

kinds.description: The graph's kinds, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

primary.description: The name of each instance's primary line; main when absent.

snapshotEvery.description: How many commits past the nearest snapshot on its chain a commit is snapshotted at, as @versionGraph's snapshotEvery; 64 when absent.

sweep.description: Turns the sweep schedule on for the schema: each run discards the drafts idle past abandonAfter, then deletes the rows of refs discarded longer ago than discardGrace, prunes each kind's history past its retentionDays and writes missing snapshots.

abandonAfter.description: Discards a draft with no write for this many milliseconds; none when absent.

discardGrace.description: How long a discarded ref's rows are kept, in milliseconds; seven days when absent.

intervalMs.description: How often it runs, in milliseconds; at least 1000.

pruneBatch.description: At most this many history images of each kind pruned per run; no limit when absent.

escalate.description: Moves the instance's Workflow status when usage leaves it over the limit of a meter, while the status is one of from, in the transaction of that usage: an instance's own usage, or one an instance inside it passes up, so a scope's config moves the scope. A move a guard vetoes or the caller may not make leaves the status, and the usage counts all the same. Needs Workflow on the type.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other state it stays.

transition.description: The state to move to, through Workflow's transition.

limitPermission.description: The permission a principal needs to change a meter's limit, with setLimit or through limitField. Absent, no limit changes once the instance exists.

limit.description: The most the instance may have used and reserved together; with limitField, the limit while the field holds no value of at least 0. No limit of its own when neither gives one.

limitField.description: An integer field of the type that holds the instance's limit; while it holds no value of at least 0, limit is the limit, and without limit there is none. Only a principal with limitPermission changes it once the instance exists.

reserve.description: The amount reserve takes for the meter when it is given no meter: what a claim reserves. With reserveField, the amount when the field holds no positive integer.

reserveField.description: An integer field of the type whose positive value is the amount reserve takes for the meter when it is given no meter, in place of reserve.

reset.description: daily: the used amount starts again at 0 at each UTC day; reservations are kept.

scope.description: A link of the type's Links config whose target is the enclosing scope: its schema composes Budget with the same meter, and every reservation and usage of the meter here is taken there too, and on up its own scope.

meters.description: The meters, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

onExceeded.description: A directive sent to the holder of the instance's active lease, through Lease's direct, when usage takes the instance or an enclosing scope over its limit: once per meter per lease. Needs Lease on the type.

direct.description: The directive's name. Its data is { meter, used, limit, scope }, scope being the instance over its limit as { schema, id }.

bufferMs.description: Time kept free around each hold, which counts against capacity as the hold does.

after.description: Milliseconds after a hold that no other may overlap; 0 when absent.

before.description: Milliseconds before a hold that no other may overlap; 0 when absent.

capacity.description: How many holds may overlap at any instant: a count, or an own integer field of the type ({ field }) whose value of at least 1 is the instance's; 1 when absent.

field.description: An own integer field of the type, by JSON key.

horizonMs.description: How far ahead a hold may start, by the engine's clock; no limit when absent.

hours.description: The weekly opening hours an instance has until it sets its own: each day, mon to sun, a list of [open, close] wall-time ranges, each closing after it opens, none overlapping. A day absent or empty is closed.

prefixItems.description: A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.
A wall time, HH:MM, from 00:00 to 24:00.

leadMs.description: How long ahead of its start a hold must be made, by the engine's clock; 0 when absent.

maxMs.description: The longest hold, in milliseconds; a day when absent.

minMs.description: The shortest hold, in milliseconds; slotMs when absent.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to set an instance's hours and to add or remove its closures; a closure over held time needs its .override. Nobody may when absent.

slotMs.description: The start grid, in milliseconds: a hold starts a whole number of slots after an opening time. Any whole minute when absent.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the hours are wall times in, such as Europe/London; an instance may set its own.

blocks.description: The block kinds a post or an edit may give; every kind when absent, none when empty.

editWindowMs.description: How long after posting its author may edit a message, in milliseconds; no limit when absent. A caller holding moderatePermission is not held to it.

maxBodyLength.description: The longest body a post or an edit may give, in code points; 40000 when absent.

moderatePermission.description: The permission that lets a caller edit and delete another's message, edit past editWindowMs, and purge. Absent, only a message's author edits or deletes it, and nobody purges.

pinPermission.description: The permission a caller needs to pin and unpin. Absent, any caller the policy lets write may.

resolvePermission.description: The permission that lets a caller resolve and reopen another's thread. Absent, only a thread's author does.

fields.description: The type's own top-level fields, by JSON key, that keep the value their create gives them.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to change them after the create; nobody may when absent.

gatedStates.description: The states of the type's Workflow that a transition into waits for every blocker to finish; every terminal state when absent.

satisfiedBy.description: The outcomes of a blocker's terminal state that finish it; success when absent. A blocker in a terminal state whose outcome the list lacks blocks until it is removed.

schemas.description: The schemas whose instances may block this type's, each composing Workflow; the type's own schema when absent.

from.description: The own top-level fields the value is derived from, never the field itself or another derived field.

instruction.description: What the model is asked, given the inputs.

model.description: A label the deployment maps to a provider's model, which the engine only compares.

states.description: The states of the type's Workflow in which the field is derived; every state when absent.

fields.description: The derived fields, by own top-level field.

maxAttempts.description: How many failed attempts a field takes before it waits for its inputs to move; 3 when absent.

permission.description: The permission a deriver needs to pull, settle and apply values.

commitOn.description: The states whose entry commits what is held; a move into one while an item is not held is refused.

each.description: An own list field of the type whose elements each name a supply of schema: one item per element.

field.description: An own list field of the type, by JSON key: one item per element.

target.description: The field of each element, by JSON key, that holds the supply's id.

interval.description: Timed supply: the time each item asks, from start to end, or to durationMs after start. start and end are date-time fields of the list's element for an each hold, own fields of the type for a link hold.

durationMs.description: How long it lasts, in milliseconds.

end.description: The date-time field it ends at, by JSON key.

start.description: The date-time field the interval starts at, by JSON key.

link.description: A single-valued link of the type's Links config whose target is the supply: one item.

quantity.description: Counted supply: the units each item asks, a count or a field ({ field }), an integer field of the list's element for an each hold, an own field of the type for a link hold.

schema.description: The supply's schema, for an each hold: it composes a supply, such as Stock or Calendar.

holds.description: The holds, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

maxItems.description: The most items the claim's holds may ask together; 100 when absent.

releaseOn.description: The states whose entry releases what is held, such as a hold's expiry or a cancellation.

returnOn.description: The states whose entry returns the units of counted supply the claim committed.

takeOn.description: The states of the type's Workflow whose entry takes the holds, and the create into one of them; the create alone when absent.

acquirePermission.description: The permission a principal needs to acquire a lease. Absent, any principal who may write the instance can.

directOn.description: Directives the engine's runner sends the holder of an instance's active lease when the target of one of the instance's links moves on: a new revision of Revisions, or a release of Branches; for a pinned link, a revision tells only the instances the target moved past. The runner sends each with direct, as its principal, which needs directPermission, or overridePermission when that is absent, once per lease and move (dedupeKey). An instance with no lease held hears nothing, and its next holder nothing either. Needs Links on the type; one entry per link.

data.description: Its data, beside revised, which the runner sets: the link, the target's schema and id, and its revision or the release's commit.

name.description: The directive's name, as direct takes it.

revised.description: The link whose target's move sends the directive.

link.description: A link of the type's Links config.

directPermission.description: The permission a principal needs to send the holder a directive; overridePermission when absent. With neither, direct is refused.

escalate.description: Used instead of onExpiry at the expiry or abandon that reaches maxExpiries, which it needs. Needs Workflow on the type.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other state it stays.

transition.description: The state to move to, through Workflow's transition.

exempt.description: Writing operations of the type's other behaviors, each as <Behavior>.<operation>, that a principal other than the holder may run while the lease is active, and that requireToken does not hold to the token.

heartbeatMs.description: How often the holder should send a heartbeat, in milliseconds, at most half of ttlMs, so one late heartbeat does not lose the lease; a third of ttlMs when absent. acquire returns it.

maxExpiries.description: How many expiries an instance may have, abandons included. Once it has had this many, its lease cannot be acquired again until resetExpiries.

maxHoldField.description: An integer field of the type that gives the instance's own longest hold, in milliseconds. When the instance holds a positive integer there, it overrides maxHoldMs.

maxHoldMs.description: The longest a principal may hold a lease after acquiring it, in milliseconds, renewed or not; no limit when absent.

onExpiry.description: Moves the instance's Workflow status when a lease ends with the work unfinished: at an expiry, an abandon and a release, while the status is one of from. Needs Workflow on the type.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other state it stays.

transition.description: The state to move to, through Workflow's transition.

overridePermission.description: The permission that lets a principal release another principal's lease, change the instance while another principal holds its lease, reset its expiries, and send directives when directPermission is absent.

requireToken.description: When true, a write to an instance with an active lease that does not present the current token as Lease's precondition is refused, the holder's own included, so every process of a principal fences its writes. Exempt and read-only operations, Lease's own operations and a principal with overridePermission are not held to it.

sweepMs.description: How often the engine's runner expires the leases past their expiry time or longest hold, in milliseconds; 5000 when absent.

ttlMs.description: How long a lease lasts after its acquire or its last heartbeat, in milliseconds; 60000 when absent.

many.description: The link holds a list of targets, in the order they were linked, rather than one.

max.description: For a many-valued link, the most targets it holds, from 1 to 100.

pinned.description: What the link records of the target, reporting the target's latest beside it and whether the target has moved past it: true or revision, its revision, whose schema must compose Revisions; release, its release, whose schema must compose Branches; false or absent, nothing.

required.description: Every create gives the link, which can then be moved to another target but not unlinked, and the delete of its target is refused. A many-valued link holds at least one target, and only the delete of its last is refused.

schema.description: The schema of the instance the link points at.

links.description: The links an instance may hold, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

format.description: How a number prints: text with {seq}, or {seq:N} zero-padded to N digits (1 to 10), exactly once, and {yyyy} or {yy}, the UTC year the instance was created in, as often as wanted. No other {...} is allowed.

reset.description: yearly starts the count again at 1 each UTC year, the year the instance was created in; the format must then print the year, {yyyy} or {yy}.

scope.description: Counts per target of a link of the type's Links config, which is required and holds one target: each target's instances are numbered 1, 2, 3, ... of their own.

link.description: The link's name in the type's Links config.

afterRelease.description: What becomes of money captured while the instance is in a voidOn state, such as a payment reported after a hold expired: refund records a refund of it; keep leaves it for an operator. keep when absent.

amount.description: What the instance owes: an own integer field of the type, in the currency's minor units ({ field }), or the claim's Holds.total ({ holds: true }), which carries its currency.

field.description: An own integer field of the type, by JSON key, such as a Finance.Money field.

capture.description: automatic: a provider captures what it authorizes. manual: captureOn states capture it. automatic when absent.

captureOn.description: With capture manual, the states whose entry captures what is authorized.

currency.description: The currency of an amount from a field: an ISO 4217 code, or an own Finance.Currency field of the type ({ field }) that holds one. Holds.total carries its own.

oneOf.description: An ISO 4217 code; the engine checks it is one.

field.description: An own Finance.Currency field of the type, by JSON key.

issueOn.description: With refundOf, the states whose entry asks the linked instance to refund the amount.

record.description: Who reports what providers did: the adapter's principal.

permission.description: The permission recordPaymentEvent needs: the adapter's service holds it.

refundOf.description: Makes the instance a refund of the instance a link names: its amount is refunded from that instance's payments.

link.description: A required, single-valued link of the type's Links config to the instance refunded, which composes Payments.

refunds.description: Who refunds directly; nobody, but a refund instance, when absent.

require.description: Per state of the type's Workflow, what a move into it waits for: authorized, every amount due authorized or paid; paid, every amount due captured.

voidOn.description: The states whose entry cancels the open attempts and voids the authorized ones.

onBeat.description: Moves the instance's Workflow status at a beat, while the status is one of from: the way back from the state onMissed moves it to. Needs Workflow on the type.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other state it stays.

transition.description: The state to move to, through Workflow's transition.

onMissed.description: Moves the instance's Workflow status when it is missed, while the status is one of from. Needs Workflow on the type.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other state it stays.

transition.description: The state to move to, through Workflow's transition.

principalField.description: A string field of the type that holds the subject of the principal the instance stands for, the only principal that may beat it. Once set, it cannot change.

releaseLeases.description: Schemas that compose Lease, whose leases the principal holds are expired when the instance is missed, through Lease's schema-level expireHolder, but for a lease renewed after the principal's last beat, whose own heartbeats show it alive. The principal that applies the miss, the runner's in the sweep, needs Lease's overridePermission on each.

sweepMs.description: How often the engine's runner misses the instances past their deadline, in milliseconds; 5000 when absent.

ttlMs.description: How long the instance stays present after its create or its last beat, in milliseconds.

fields.description: The own top-level fields it records; every one when absent.

reviewed.description: The recorded fields that must not be proposed, or all.

gates.description: By state of the type's Workflow, the fields a move into it requires out of review.

review.description: Which writes enter review, and who reviews them.

below.description: A confidence at or above which a write is accepted with no reviewer; every write from a source is proposed when absent.

permission.description: The permission a reviewer needs to accept or reject.

sources.description: The behaviors whose writes enter review, each one the type composes.

claim.description: The Workflow states an instance is claimed from, and the state a claim moves it to.

from.description: The states an instance can be claimed in; a transition from each to the claimed state must exist.

to.description: The state a claim moves the instance to.

excludeStale.description: Pinned links of the type's Links config: an instance one of which is pinned to a revision or a release its target has moved past is not claimed, and is no candidate until a change of it, a new link say, lets it back in.

match.description: The type's own top-level scalar fields claimNext and countClaimable may filter on, by equality with a value or membership in a list of values.

maxCandidates.description: The most instances one claimNext tries before it gives up; 100 when absent.

priorityField.description: An integer field of the type that orders claimNext: higher first, an instance without a value last. Absent, oldest first.

rules.description: The rules, each one when and one then, in the order they run.

then.description: What the rule does: move the instance, or the instance its link points to, to a state through Workflow's transition.

link.description: A link of the type's Links config: the target is the instance it points to. The instance itself when absent.

transition.description: The state to move the target to.

when.description: What sets the rule off: one of enters, changes, allTerminal, anyTerminal, holds and revised.

allTerminal.description: The rule fires on an instance when an instance of schema that links to it through link changes or goes, and every instance that links to it there is in a terminal state of its own schema's Workflow, with an outcome outcomes lists when it is given, at least one.

link.description: The link of that schema's Links config that points at this type's schema.

outcomes.description: The outcomes a linking instance's terminal state must have; every outcome when absent.

schema.description: The schema of the linking instances, which composes Links and Workflow.

anyTerminal.description: The rule fires on an instance when an instance of schema that links to it through link enters a terminal state of its own schema's Workflow whose outcome outcomes lists, by a create or a transition, or is linked to it while in one.

link.description: The link of that schema's Links config that points at this type's schema.

outcomes.description: The outcomes of the terminal states that set the rule off.

schema.description: The schema of the linking instances, which composes Links and Workflow.

changes.description: The rule fires when a create, an update or an operation of the instance moves the value of field: to to when it is given, from from when it is given. A create moves a field from absent; a delete sets nothing off.

field.description: An own field of the type, by its JSON key, or a field of a behavior the type lists, by qualified name (Workflow.status), a member path after it allowed (Lease.ended.reason). A volatile field, which moves at a read with no event, and Workflow.enteredAt, which moves with the status, are refused.

from.description: The value the field moves from; any value when absent. A create moves a field from absent, which from never names.

to.description: The value the field moves to; any value when absent.

enters.description: A state of the type's Workflow: the rule fires when the instance's status becomes it, by a create or a transition.

holds.description: An all or any rollup of the type's Rollups config: the rule fires on an instance when an instance of the rollup's schema changes, links, unlinks or goes, and that change makes the rollup hold: it holds after it, and would not with that instance as it was before it, the other linked instances as they are when the rule runs.

revised.description: The rule fires on an instance when the instance its link points to gains a new revision of Revisions, or, when its schema composes Branches, a new release (releaseCommit). For a link pinned to a revision, only an instance a new revision leaves stale, and for one pinned to a release, only an instance a new release leaves stale.

link.description: A link of the type's Links config.

attempts.description: How many failures of the class an instance may have.

hint.description: What recordAttempt returns for a failure of the class, to steer the worker's next attempt.

classes.description: The failure classes, by name: each its own cap of attempts, with an optional hint for the next attempt, or terminal, which exhausts the instance at its first failure.

exhaustedState.description: The state of the type's Workflow an exhausted instance moves to.

from.description: The states exhaustion moves the status from; every state but the terminal ones and exhaustedState when absent. A transition from each to exhaustedState must exist.

keepBest.description: Keeps the best scoring result rather than only a success's: a failed attempt's result is kept when its score beats the best kept one by at least minDelta and no neverRegress predicate that held for the kept one fails.

minDelta.description: How much a score must beat the best kept one by; any amount above it when absent.

neverRegress.description: Predicates an attempt reports that a kept result never loses: one true for the kept result must be true for the next one kept.

limitsField.description: An object field of the type with the instance's own caps: a class's name to a cap of at least 0, and totalAttempts to a total of at least 1. An unknown or terminal class, and a value that is not such an integer, is ignored. Once the instance exists, only a principal with limitsPermission changes it, and the holder of its active lease does not.

limitsPermission.description: The permission a principal needs to change limitsField once the instance exists. Absent, the caps an instance is created with do not change.

permission.description: The permission a principal needs to record an attempt. Absent, any principal who may write the instance can.

resultField.description: A field of the type a kept result is written to, with the checks of an update.

stuckAfter.description: How many failures in a row, none of them kept, with the same signature exhaust the instance as stuck.

totalAttempts.description: How many failures of every class together an instance may have.

review.description: Turns on the review step: propose, approve, reject and listProposals.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to approve or reject a proposal.

field.description: For countBy, a string, enum or boolean field of the linked instances, or status when their schema composes Workflow; for sum, min and max, a numeric field; for latest, any field of theirs, or status when their schema composes Workflow.

function.description: count: how many instances point here. countBy: how many hold each value of field. sum, min, max: of the numeric field. latest: field's value on the instance created last, the greater id on a tie. all, any: whether every one, or some one, is in a terminal state of its schema's Workflow, with an outcome outcomes lists when it is given.

gatedStates.description: For all and any, the states of the type's Workflow that a transition into waits for the rollup to hold.

link.description: The link of that schema's Links config that points at this schema.

outcomes.description: For all and any, the outcomes a linked instance's terminal state must have to count; every outcome when absent.

schema.description: The schema whose instances point at this one; it composes Links.

rollups.description: The rollups, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

fields.description: The type's own top-level fields to index, by JSON key, each a string or a scalar whose values are strings; at most 16. Their order is the order a snippet's field is chosen in when two match equally, and the order an embedder's text joins them in.

vectors.description: Keeps a vector per instance, which an outside embedder computes from the indexed fields' text, for vector and hybrid search. A version that changes the model or the dimensions makes every vector stale.

dimensions.description: How many numbers a vector holds.

model.description: A label for the embedding model the vectors come from, which the engine only compares: an embedder computes with it, and a query vector may name it.

permission.description: The permission an embedder needs to settle vectors.

weights.description: A weight per indexed field, which multiplies that field's part of a match's score; 1 for a field it does not name.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to change a field a state freezes; nobody may when absent. What a state requires holds for every caller.

frozen.description: The type's own top-level fields, by JSON key, that do not change while the instance is in the state, or all, every one of them.

required.description: The type's own top-level fields, by JSON key, an instance must hold to enter the state, and keeps while it is in it.

states.description: The rules, by a state of the type's Workflow.

backorder.description: Whether a hold may take more than is available, leaving available below 0; false when absent.

lowAt.description: Stock.low is true while available is at or below this: a count, or an own integer field of the type ({ field }) that holds one, while it holds one. Stock.low is false when absent.

field.description: An own integer field of the type, by JSON key.

maxPerHold.description: The most units one item of a claim may hold; no limit when absent.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to receive, adjust and count stock; a count below what claims hold needs its .override.

price.description: The unit price holdFor returns and Holds keeps on each item, so a line keeps the price it was held at: an own integer field of the type and its currency. No price when absent.

currency.description: The price's currency: an ISO 4217 code, or an own Finance.Currency field of the type ({ field }) that holds one.

oneOf.description: An ISO 4217 code; the engine checks it is one.

field.description: An own Finance.Currency field of the type, by JSON key.
An own integer field of the type, by JSON key, holding the unit price in the currency's minor units, such as a Finance.Money field.

afterMs.description: How long after its start the deadline is due, in milliseconds; 0 when absent. Negative, before its start, for a field start alone.

start.description: What the deadline starts from: the instance's create ({ create: true }), each entry of the status into a state of the type's Workflow ({ enters }), or the time an own date-time field holds ({ field }), which moves the deadline when it changes and cancels it when it is cleared.

enters.description: A state of the type's Workflow; the deadline starts again at each entry into it.

field.description: An own field of the type, by JSON key, whose values are date-times.

then.description: Moves the status of the type's Workflow, through its transition, when the deadline fires while the status is one of from.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other it stays. When absent, the state the deadline starts in: its enters state, or the Workflow's initial state for a create start. A field start names them.

until.description: Cancels the deadline while it is pending once a change leaves the status out of the state it starts in ({ leaves }) or in one of the states given ({ enters }). Needs Workflow on the type.

leaves.description: The state the deadline starts in: its enters state, or the Workflow's initial state for a create start.

enters.description: States of the type's Workflow, none of them the state the deadline starts in.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to reset or snooze a deadline; nobody may when absent.

sweepMs.description: How often the engine's runner fires the due deadlines, in milliseconds; 5000 when absent.

by.description: The type's own string or enum field, by JSON key, whose value picks the type.

field.description: The type's own field the variants type, by JSON key: a Generic.JSON field, or one of a scalar whose values are JSON objects.

types.description: By a value of by, the type of the schema document, besides the instance type, that field holds while by holds the value.

initial.description: The state a new instance starts in; the first of states when absent.

outcomes.description: The outcome of each terminal state it names: success, failure or neutral. A terminal state it does not name is a success. Each key is a terminal state of states.

states.description: Every state an instance can be in.

transitions.description: The moves the status may make. A state that no transition leaves is terminal.

from.description: The state the instance is in.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to make this transition. Absent, any caller who may write the instance can.

DisplayCurrency.description: A field of the same type that holds the currency of an amount: a Finance.Currency, or text.

field.description: The field's name, or its JSON key.

DisplayState.description: How a UI shows one Workflow state: its label, the present-progressive form it shows while an instance is in the state, and a tone, what the state means to a reader.

title.description: The member's reader-facing label: no ASCII control character, U+2028 or U+2029, no space at either end, and no */.

FieldDisplay.description: How a UI renders a field's control and its value (@display on a field).

currency.description: The currency of the amount in minor units the field holds: an ISO 4217 code (GBP), or a field of the same type that holds one.

multiline.description: A control that holds several lines (true) or one line (false), whatever the field's maxLength; absent leaves it to the UI.

OperationPage.description: The operation's list result pages by an opaque cursor (@paginated): it takes the query parameters cursor and limit and answers {items, next}. A member left out takes its default.

defaultLimit.description: How many items a page holds when the caller sends no limit: 20, or maxLimit when that is less.

defaultSort.description: The order of a request that sends no sort: one of the SortBy argument's values, a field or - and a field. Required with a SortBy argument, and refused without one.

maxLimit.description: The most items a caller may ask a page to hold: 1 to 1000, 100 when left out.

TypeDisplay.description: What a UI reads to render the instances of a type (@display): what to call one and many, which field is an instance's title, what a create button says, the glyph shown beside its name, which fields summarize it in a list, and the labels of its Workflow's states and transitions.

createLabel.description: What a button that creates an instance says.

icon.description: The glyph a UI shows beside the type's name, by a name an app's icon set draws: a letter or a digit, then letters, digits, ., _, :, / and -.

states.description: Labels of states of the type's Workflow, by state.

summaryFields.description: The fields that summarize an instance in a list, in order: the type's own, by name, or fields its behaviors add, by qualified name (Workflow.status).

titleField.description: The field whose value is an instance's title: one of the type's own, a single text value.

transitions.description: Labels of transitions of the type's Workflow, by the state a transition leaves, then by the state it enters.

metaSchema.description: A Superschematic source file in the JSON or YAML projection: a multi-definition document mirroring the Schema IR, or a single definition object.
metaSchema.title: Superschematic schema file
